title: Research developers as users
summary: When your users are developers, research how they actually work: their tools, their workflows and what slows them down.

beginner: Identify the developer groups who use or will use your platform.
Watch them complete a real task with your product.
Ask about their tools, workflow and biggest time-wasters.
Look at support tickets, forum posts and usage data.
Summarise the top pain points with evidence.
intermediate: Observe real tasks and review usage data.
experienced: Measure developer experience with time-to-first-success and satisfaction.
Use research to shape the platform roadmap.

canDelegateTo.task: Plan and run sessions with developers

toolExamples.github: Review issues and discussions for recurring problems.
toolExamples.gitlab: Review issues and merge request comments for pain points.
toolExamples.miro: Map the developer workflow and mark pain points.

pitfalls: Assuming you know because you are technical
